canonical.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/4. DP on Subsequences/02. Partition array in two equal sum subsets.cpp

narrative.title: The Twin Locker Allocation
narrative.scenario: A gym equips two identical lockers and must split a shipment of weighted plates between them so both lockers carry exactly the same load. Plates are rigid — no splitting in half. The intake scanner answers one question per shipment: can the plates be divided into two perfectly balanced groups?
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n positive integers.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if nums can be split into two subsets with equal sums, otherwise false.

testCases.explanation: Locker A takes 11; locker B takes 1 + 5 + 5 = 11.
The total 11 is odd, so equal halves are impossible.

hintLevels: Level 1: Equal halves means one group must reach total/2 — check that single target.
Level 2: If the total is odd, bail immediately; otherwise run subset-sum against total/2.
Level 3: The odd-total early exit is both a correctness and a performance win.
